Title: Requires standards for an electronic prior authorization program for the utilization review of health care services
Summary: Requires the commissioner of health and the superintendent of insurance to develop standards for an electronic prior authorization program for the utilization review of health care services.
LawCode: Amd §4903, Pub Health L; amd §4903, Ins L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law and the insurance law, in relation to an electronic prior authorization program for the utilization review of health care services
